byUser.loadFailed: Failed to load profit by cashier
byUser.caption: Excludes counterparty discounts — not attributable to a single cashier. Transactions is the count Avg Profit/Txn divides by — refunds and supplier settlements are not counted separately.

byClient.loadFailed: Failed to load profit by client
byClient.caption: Excludes exchange profit and counterparty discounts — not attributable to a single client. Transactions counts the same events as By Cashier — refunds and supplier settlements are not counted separately.
byClient.top30: Showing the top 30 clients by profit for this period, ranked by USD profit (LBP-only profit is not included in the ranking).

commissions.realizedNote: Commission, fees and kept change already booked. Excludes bills-only settlement commission (see Overview → Supplier Commission).
commissions.ringsNote: Inner ring: transfer/transaction volume moved through each provider (not profit). Outer ring: commission pending, as of now. LBP figures are in the table.
commissions.awaitingCaption: {{n}} awaiting settlement — commission unknown until settled, not reflected in the chart above
commissions.performanceTitle: Provider Performance (Selected Period / As Of Now)

pending.awaitingTitle: Post-cutover OMT/WHISH/BILL rows — the real commission is unknowable until settlement, so this is a count, never a $ figure.
pending.willRealize: Will be realized after settlement with supplier
pending.deferredNote: Already stamped, not yet earned — separate from the unpaid sales below (recognized once the partner or client pays), and not included in any total on this page.
pending.pendingProfitSub: Recognized once each sale is fully paid — partner-obligation sales are tracked separately in the Deferred card above
pending.unpaidNote: Unpaid sales below are shown regardless of the date range above — pending means as of now, not "unpaid within this period".
